editorial.name: Flourish Commerce
editorial.descriptionZh: 专做电商转化率审计的小工作室官网，三天交付一份按 effort 与 impact 排序的页面级改动清单，也接后续的设计和开发。
editorial.takeawayZh: 买一份按优先级排好的转化率改动清单
editorial.noteZh: 米色底，衬线大字 Get a custom CRO audit for your eCommerce store，按钮 Get Your Audit 和 I Need Design/Dev Help。紧接着直接摊开一份审计样本：左边是 Milk x Whiskey 的商品图，黄色圆点 1 到 4 标出问题位置；右边对着同编号的结论，例如 Show items in context so users can get a sense of size, scale, and usage 标 EFFORT: High / IMPACT: Medium，Include star rating and review count 标 EFFORT: Medium / IMPACT: Very High。再往下是 3-STEP PROCESS：01 GET YOUR AUDIT（We'll audit your eCommerce website or design file in 3 days or less.）、02 IMPLEMENT RECOMMENDATIONS、03 CONVERT MORE CUSTOMERS，并写明 On average, our clients see a 30% lift in conversion rates。What's included? 一栏把 Insights、Recommendations、Prioritize、Share 四项拆开，最后是一个 Discover your untapped revenue potential 的 ROI 计算器。

reasons.statement: 用户花钱买到的是对自家电商站的转化率审计：一份带 EFFORT / IMPACT 评级、可 share 给团队、可直接 hand-off 给开发的清单，动作是 audit 与 purchase，因此归可用性测试与实验。
首页 What's included? 一栏写 Insights 来自 Data-backed insights cited from 1000+ studies and user research.，产物是研究报告而不是设计资产或代码。
